name: avatar-circles
title: Avatar Circles
description: A compact avatar group where round photos overlap shoulder to shoulder and end in a light disc showing how many more people there are.
use: A compact group of users plus a count is needed as social proof or a member preview.
avoid: The trailing count disc ships with an empty link, so it goes nowhere until you wire it up.
a11y: Photos get generic alt text like Avatar 1, the count disc has no accessible name, and the links have no visible focus style. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Five round photos lined up on black, each cropped to a circle and ringed with a thin white border. They overlap by about a third, and a solid white circle holding +99 in black caps the row.
behaves: Static: the row does not move or respond in the frames. The trailing count is a link whose background darkens on hover.
customise: Pass avatarUrls as an array of imageUrl and profileUrl pairs plus numPeople for the trailing count; ring colour, size and overlap are fixed classes.
weight: light: A short row of small images and one text label; nothing animates.
